title: Pneumothorax at 20 s: peak and plateau both rise
summary: An abrupt fall in compliance with a pleural pressure offset: Ppeak and Pplat rise together, driving pressure rises, and in the truth layer pleural pressure jumps. Compare with bronchospasm.
objectives: Distinguish a compliance fall (both Ppeak and Pplat up) from a resistance rise (Ppeak only).
Chest drain (remove the injector) restores the baseline.
